title: Customers See Their Own Ledger
description: One customer's invoices are their own business — not another customer's, and not something a driver should be able to browse. The Billing page's row visibility has to match SwiftCargo's ownership rules exactly.
successCondition: With two distinct customer accounts each having booked and invoiced at least one shipment, logging in as customer A's /billing page shows only customer A's shipment/invoice rows (customer B's shipment id never appears), logging in as customer B shows the mirror image, and logging in as admin (or dispatcher) shows both customers' rows together on the same page.
hints: Register two fresh customer accounts via /register if the seeded data doesn't already give you two distinct customers with invoices.
Check by shipment id presence/absence in the DOM, not by row count alone — a count-only check could pass even if the wrong rows leaked through.
